FluidR3 General MIDI soundfont samples
Original soundfont: Frank Wen and contributors (FluidR3_GM).
Rendered MP3 assets: Benjamin Gleitzman, midi-js-soundfonts.
Source: https://github.com/gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts/tree/gh-pages/FluidR3_GM

Changes: selected MIDI notes 40 through 84 for acoustic_grand_piano and
acoustic_guitar_steel; repackaged as JSON data URLs without changing audio.
